Offer terms · Email privacy

Your welcome treat

New newsletter subscribers can receive 5% off after confirming their subscription. Existing Elio customers can join too, if they are new newsletter subscribers.

Minimum product subtotal ₱500; maximum discount ₱100. Delivery fees are excluded. Your unique code expires 14 days after newsletter confirmation and can be used once.

The code is emailed to you. To use it, sign in to an email-verified Elio account with the same email address you subscribed with. You may use one promo code per order.

Your email, your choice

We use your email address to send Elio news, special offers, and exclusive promo codes, manage your subscription, and check eligibility for your welcome code. Signup is optional, and we ask you to confirm your email before newsletter messages begin.

You can unsubscribe through the link in any newsletter. This does not stop the account or order emails you need for your purchases.

For help with your subscription or a request about your email address, contact elio.cheesecakes@gmail.com.
